titel: Round model on one tiny point? Give it a flat bottom 🥚 #blender #3dprinting
printzin: Every printer is different: print a small test first.

scenes.tekst: Does your round model touch the bed in just one tiny point?
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: Give it a flat bottom in Blender, with a few keys, before you slice.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Press Tab for Edit Mode, then 1 for vertex select.
scenes.label: STEP 1
scenes.uitspraak: Press Tab for Edit Mode, then one for vertex select.

scenes.tekst: Press 1 on the numpad for the front view, then Alt Z to see through.
scenes.label: STEP 2
scenes.uitspraak: Press one on the numpad for the front view, then Alt Z to see through.

scenes.tekst: Drag a box around the bottom rows of points.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: Press S, then Z, then 0, and Enter. The points line up flat.
scenes.label: STEP 4
scenes.uitspraak: Press S, then Z, then zero, and Enter. The points line up flat.

scenes.tekst: Select more rows for a wider base, or fewer rows to keep more of the round shape.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Now it stands on a flat circle about 29 mm wide, instead of one point.
scenes.label: FLAT
scenes.uitspraak: Now it stands on a flat circle, about twenty nine millimeters wide, instead of one point.

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different, so print a small test first. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
scenes.uitspraak: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
